name: Subscription Renewal Compliance Kit
short_description: Organize disclosure, consent, and cancellation reviews for subscription offers with checklists, test scripts, and a 30/60/90-day plan.
long_description: A practical operations kit for US subscription and membership sellers reviewing auto-renewal disclosure, consent records, and cancellation paths under ROSCA and state automatic-renewal statutes. Includes an operating guide, a five-sheet Excel workbook with status formulas, and three editable Word templates. Structures evidence filing and counsel handoff without promising any legal outcome.
buyer_persona: Founders and operations managers at US businesses with subscriptions, memberships, or auto-renewing service agreements who need an organized review method and evidence file.
problem_statement: Auto-renewal disclosure, consent, and cancellation practices face federal baseline rules plus roughly 30 state statutes, multi-million-dollar settlements in 2024-2026, and a March 2026 FTC ANPRM signaling possible federal movement. Teams lack a structured way to review every surface and channel.
outcome_statement: A dated baseline of current disclosure, consent, and cancellation practice, logged gaps with owners, state verification dates tracked, and a sequenced remediation plan with filed evidence.
whats_included: Operating guide PDF (15 sections); Excel workbook with 5 sheets: Disclosure Audit Log, Consent-Flow Checklist, Cancellation-Path Test Log, State-Law Register, Remediation Tracker; 3 Word templates: cancellation-path test script, disclosure review sign-off, remediation plan memo; README with file map.
who_for: Operations and support leads running audits
Teams preparing a structured package for counsel
who_not_for: Buyers seeking legal advice or legal conclusions
how_to_use: Run the two-hour quick start, then work the five passes in order: map surfaces, audit disclosure, audit consent, test cancellation, consolidate into the tracker and remediation plan with counsel review.
limitations: General operational information only. Ships with no pre-filled state requirements. Timed trials reflect test conditions on the test date. Workbook rollups describe evidence completeness, not legal standing. Verify state law locally with qualified counsel.
disclaimer: Not legal advice, verify with qualified counsel. Verify state law locally for every state where you market or hold customers. This kit makes no promise about legal outcomes and never claims compliance guarantees or specific penalty immunity.
